verdict.rationale: Orrick Tech Studio advertises 50+ customizable forms and document generators, free with no registration. Specific interactive tools are documented: a Convertible Note Financing Term Sheet Creator, a German Incorporation Questionnaire, and a GenAI Policy Builder that creates a draft policy. A community user also independently points to Orrick's term sheet generator wizard. Missing for 10: detail on how assembly works (branching logic, output formats, download or e-sign of the finished document), and recent hands-on corroboration, since the community evidence is dated.
